# Apogee

Apogee is an offline-first, private browser extension for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox. It runs LLM inference on-device using WebGPU (WebLLM), WebAssembly (Transformers.js), or local servers over loopback (Ollama, llama.cpp). It summarizes web content, YouTube/Bilibili videos, and PDFs, and answers questions using on-device retrieval.

## Important Files

- `apogee-extension/manifest.json`: Manifest V3 configuration for Chromium and Firefox.
- `apogee-extension/background/service-worker.js`: Background service worker and message routing.
- `apogee-extension/popup/`: Extension popup UI (HTML, CSS, JS).
- `apogee-extension/lib/engines/`: LLM engine implementations (WebLLM, Transformers.js, Ollama, llama.cpp).
- `apogee-extension/lib/engines/llamaCppClient.js`: SSE streaming client and health/context detection for a local `llama-server`.
- `apogee-extension/content/extractors/`: Site-specific article and video text extractors (YouTube, Bilibili, Wikipedia, Gmail, Reddit, Hacker News, GitHub, Lobsters, arXiv, Mastodon, Stack Overflow, Lemmy, Discourse, Bluesky).
- `apogee-extension/lib/extract/`: Extraction router and local file parsing (`pageExtraction.js`, `selection.js`, `pdfExtract.js`, `docxExtract.js`).
- `apogee-extension/lib/extract/pdfExtract.js`: Client-side PDF text extraction using pdf.js.
- `apogee-extension/lib/summarize/mapReduce.js`: Hierarchical map-reduce with tree-folding for long inputs (every chunk mapped, partials folded in groups of `fanIn` until within `getMaxChunks` budget, OOM-safe fallbacks).
- `apogee-extension/lib/retrieval/rag.js`: Embedding generation, vector similarity retrieval (Ask), and grounding logic.
- `apogee-extension/lib/retrieval/pastSummariesSearch.js`: On-device semantic vector search across past saved summaries.
- `apogee-extension/lib/util/userError.js`: `UserFacingError` class and `toUserMessage()` fallback mapper for sanitizing raw engine/browser errors before they reach users.
- `apogee-extension/offscreen/`: Offscreen document environment for WebGPU, WASM, and embedding execution on Chromium.
- `apogee-extension/tests/`: Node-based test suite, extractor tests, and HTML fixtures.

## Architecture

General processing flow:

Web Page / Video / PDF
-> Content Extraction
-> Text Chunking
-> Local LLM
-> Summary / Q&A
-> UI

Ask and sentence highlighting flow:

Content
-> Chunking
-> Local Embeddings (all-MiniLM-L6-v2)
-> Similarity Retrieval
-> Relevant Passages
-> Local LLM / Highlighting

## Quick Instructions for AI Agents

- **Node Version**: Node.js 22 or newer (.nvmrc pins 22).
- **Commands** (run `install:extension`, `build`, `test`, `lint`, `format`, `dev`, `package` from root or inside apogee-extension; `format:check`, `build:chrome`, `build:firefox`, `start:*`, `lint:webext` only inside apogee-extension):
  - `npm install`: Install dependencies.
  - `npm run dev`: Watch mode. Rebuilds dist/chrome and dist/firefox on save.
  - `npm run build`: Build Chromium (dist/chrome) and Firefox (dist/firefox) packages.
  - `npm test`: Run Node test suite (node --test).
  - `npm run lint`: Run ESLint check.
  - `npm run format:check`: Check formatting with Prettier.

## Development Notes

- Do not introduce cloud APIs or remote inference services.
- Do not send page content, transcripts, PDFs, questions, or summaries to external servers.
- Keep inference compatible with the existing WebGPU, WebAssembly, Ollama, and llama.cpp architecture.
- Run `npm test` and `npm run lint` before submitting changes.
- Extractor changes must include or update Node-based HTML fixtures and tests.
